questions.question: 16a² + 4b² + 9c² - 16ab + 12bc - 24ca = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

16a2 + 4b2 + 9c2 - 16ab + 12bc - 24ca 

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 16a2 + 4b2 + 9c2 - 16ab + 12bc - 24ca 

⇒ (4a)² + (-2b)² +(-3c)² +2{ 4a(-2b) + (-2b)(-3c) + 4a(-3c) }

⇒ (4a - 2b - 3c)²

**∴ the required value is (4a - 2b - 3c)².**

questions.question: A work is done by P & Q, Q & R, and R & P in 12, 15, and 20 days, respectively. How many days will P alone take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:-** Work done by P & Q = 12 days, Q & R = 15 days, and R & P = 20 days

**To find:-** Time taken by P alone to complete the work

**Formula used:-** work done = Efficiency × time taken

Calculation**:-** According to the question,

⇒P & Q = 12 days

⇒Q & R = 15 days

⇒R & P = 20 days

**Let the total work be the LCM(12, 15, 20)**

⇒Total work = 4 × 3 × 5 = 60 units

The efficiency can be calculated by using (work done)/(time taken),

⇒Effciency of P & Q = {60over12} = 5

⇒Effciency of Q & R = {60over15} = 4

⇒Effciency of R & P = {60over20} = 3

Let the efficiency of P, Q, and R be p, q, and r

⇒p + q = 5, q + r = 4 and r + p = 3

In solving the above three equations,

The efficiency of P, Q, and R will be 2, 3, and 1 respectively

So, If P works alone to complete the work then the time can be calculated by using the formula, work done = Efficiency × time taken

⇒60 = 2 × Time taken

⇒30 = Time taken

**The time taken by the P to complete the work is 30 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Time Work Efficiency

⇒ (P + Q) 12 60 5

⇒ (Q + R) 15 60 4

⇒ (P + R) 20 60 3

⇒ (P + Q + R) = 6 (efficiency)

⇒ P = (P + Q + R) - (Q + R)

⇒ P = 6 - 4

⇒ P = 2

Time is taken by P to complete the work alone 

⇒ 60/2

⇒ 30

**∴ The answer is 30 days.**

questions.question: A batsman in his 11th inning scores 88 runs, thereby increasing his average score by 4. What is his average after the 11th innings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = Runs in current innings − (Previous innings × Increase in average)

Runs scored in current (11th) innings = 88 runs

Total runs used to increase the average of previous 10 innings = 10 × 4 = 40 runs

New Average = 88 − 40 = 48 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 48 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Score in 11th innings = 88 runs

Increase in average score = 4 runs

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6518bb734d59765f33f149097be9545929948d9801b2e856b11fce8c5d81046.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the average score after 10 innings be x.

⇒ Total runs after 10 innings = 10 × x = 10x

⇒ Total runs after 11 innings = 10x + 88

⇒ New average after 11 innings = x + 4

⇒ (10x + 88) ÷ 11 = x + 4

⇒ 10x + 88 = 11 × (x + 4)

⇒ 10x + 88 = 11x + 44

⇒ 11x − 10x = 88 − 44

⇒ x = 44

⇒ Average after 11th innings = x + 4 = 44 + 4 = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all items from their average is always zero. A new average can be calculated directly by adjusting the net deviation.

Change in Every Observation

If every observation in a set is increased, decreased, multiplied, or divided by a constant value, the new average will also undergo the same mathematical operation.

⇒ Total valid votes are=Total votes-Invalid votes=7500-2250=5250

⇒The First candidate got valid votes are=40% of valid votes=(5250 times 40)/(100)=2100

⇒ Second candidate get valid votes= Total valid votes- votes got the first candidate=5250-2100=3150 votes

**Hence, the ****Other candidate won by 3150 valid votes**

questions.question: A dishonest dealer is selling sugar at Rs. 40 per kg and pretending that he is selling it at a loss of Rs. 5 per kg but he actually gives 800 g instead of 1 kg, using a faulty weight. What is his actual profit or loss percent?
questions.solution:
Given:- SP = Rs. 40 /kg, used faulty weight and gave 800g in place of 1 kg

To find:- Actual profit and loss percent

Formula used:- % profit = (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100 , Loss % = (CP-SP)/(CP)times 100

Calculation:- It is mentioned in the question that he is pretending to sell a kg of sugar at a loss of Rs. 5 per kg

⇒CP - SP = 5

⇒CP = 45 per Kg (Since, SP = 40 per kg)

As given, he is using faulty weight and gives 800g instead of 1 kg,

Suppose he sells a 1 kg sugar to a customer,

⇒The CP of the 1 kg of sugar = Rs. 45 

But he actually gave 800g to a customer so the cost paid by the dealer to purchase that sugar will be,

⇒ The CP of the 800 kg of sugar = (45)/(1000)times 800 = Rs. 36

Profit % = (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100

Profit % = (40-36)/(36)times 100

\% profit = (100)/(9)

**The actual profit of a dealer is of 11 {1 over 9}%**%.

questions.question: The number 5132832 is divisible by ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:-** Number = 5132832

**To find:- **Divisibility of a number

**Concept used:-** Divisibility of 5, 6, 7 and 9

Calculation**:-** As we have to check the number whether it is divisible by 5, 6, 7, or 9 then we have to go by options,

**Checking option- 1**

**Divisibility of 5, **

If the last number is either 0 or 5, the entire number is divisible by 5

Last digit of the given number is 2

Hence the given number is not divisible by 5.

Checking option- 2

**Divisibility of 6** states that the number which is divisible by 2 and 3 is also divisible by 6

Since the number is even so it is divisible by 2

For a number to be divisible by 3, the sum of digit must have 3 as a multiple

⇒Sum = 5 +1+ 3 + 2 + 8 + 3 + 2 = 24

24 is divisible by 3 hence the number is also divisible by 3

⇒**The number is divisible by 6**

Checking option- 3

Divisibility of 7 states that twice the unit digit when subtracted from the remaining part then the outcome must be a multiple of 7

⇒513283 - 4 = 513279

On repeating this several times,

⇒51328 - 6 = 51322

⇒5132 - 4 = 5128

⇒512 - 16 = 496

⇒49 - 12 = 37

Since 37 is not a multiple of 7 hence** the number is not divisible by 7**

Checking option- 4

**Divisibility of 9 **states that if the sum of the digits of a number is divisible by 9 then the number is divisible by 9

⇒The sum of digit is 24 which is not divisible by 9 hence the **number is not divisible by 9.**

**.·. The number is divisible by 6.**

questions.question: The diagonal of a rectangle is 17 cm long and its perimeter is 46 cm. The area of the rectangle is:
questions.solution:
Given:- Diagonal = 17 cm, Permiter = 45 cm

To find:- Area of rectangle

Formula used:- Area of rectangle = Length × breadth

Calculation:- The diagonal divides the rectangle into two equal right-angled triangle

⇒Hypotenuse of right angle will be the diagonal = 17 cm

Let the length and breadth of the rectangle be 'l' and 'b' respectively

As given, **Perimeter = 46 cm**

⇒2(l + b) = 46

⇒(l + b) = 23

On squaring both sides,

⇒(l + b)² = 23²

⇒l² + b² + 2lb = 529 --------- (i)

Since the diagonal divided the rectangle into two equal right-angled triangles then by **using Pythagorean theoram**,

⇒**(hypotenuse)² = (length)² + (breadth)²**

⇒17² = l² + b²

⇒289 = l2 + b2 

Substituting the value of l2 + b2 in eq(i),

⇒289 + 2lb = 529

⇒2lb = 240

⇒lb = 120 cm²

**The area of the rectangle is 120 cm²**

questions.question: The selling price of a watch after successive discounts of 20%, and 20% is Rs. 640. What is the market price of the watch?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Selling price = Rs640

Successive discounts% = 20% and 20%

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = (1-d1/100) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price , M.P. = Marked price , d1 and d1 = successive discounts respectively

**CALCULATION:**

Here, d1 = 20% , d2 = 20% and S.P. = Rs640

640 = ( 1- 20/100) × ( 1- 20/100) × M.P.

640 = ( 1-1/5) × ( 1-1/5) × M.P.

⇒ M.P. = 640 × 5/4 × 5/4 = Rs1,000.

**Hence, Marked price is Rs1000.**

questions.question: What will be the present value of Rs. 484 due in 2 years at 10% per annum compound interest?
questions.solution:

Amount = Rs. 484

Time = 2 years

Rate = 10%

**FORMULA USED: **

A = P × ( 1 +R/100)^t 

Where, A = Amount , P = Principal, R = Rate of interest , t= Time 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, A= Rs484, R = 10% t = 2 years

484 = P × ( 1 + 10/100 ) ² 

⇒ 484 = P × 11/10 × 11/10 

⇒ P = 484 × 10/11 × 10/11 = 400.

**Hence, the Present value is Rs400.**

questions.question: A train takes 3 hours to travel from place A to B at the speed of 60 km/h. The same train takes 2 hours to travel from B to C at 50% increased speed. What is the average speed of the train from place A to C?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

From A to B

Time = 3 hours, Speed = 60 km/h

From B to C 

Time = 2 hours , Speed = 50% increased speed than A to B

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

Average Speed = Total Distance travelled/ Total time taken

**CALCULATION:**

According to the Question, 

When train travels from A to B then,

Time = 3 h ,Speed = 60 km/h 

⇒ Distance = 60 × 3 = 180 km.

Now, when train travels from B to C then,

Time = 2 h , Speed = ( 60 + 60 ×1/2) = 90 km/h 

⇒ Distance = 90 × 2 = 180 km.

⇒ Now, Total Distance travelled from A to B and from B to C = ( 180 +180) = 360 km.

⇒ Total time taken = ( 3 + 2 ) = 5 hours.

⇒ Average Speed from A to C = Total Distance travelled/ Total time taken = 360 / 5 = 72 km/h.

**Hence, Average Speed = 72 km/h.**
